Game Overview

In War Groups, the core idea is straightforward: navigate a sprawling hazardous Zone, teeming with danger and mystery. Form alliances, capture territories, and outsmart rivals to dominate. Uncover artifacts, face relentless mutants, and engage in strategic warfare across diverse sectors. The Zone awaits your command.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in War Groups is easy to pick up. Navigate a sprawling hazardous Zone, teeming with danger and mystery. Form alliances, capture territories, and outsmart rivals to dominate. Uncover artifacts, face relentless mutants, and engage in strategic warfare across diverse sectors. The Zone awaits your command.
